name: Bruschetta
shortDescription: Toasted bread with fresh tomatoes and basil
longDescription: Classic Italian appetizer featuring toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with a mixture of diced tomatoes, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil. Finished with a balsamic glaze drizzle and shaved parmesan.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms
longDescription: Tender mushroom caps filled with a savory mixture of cream cheese, garlic, herbs, and breadcrumbs. Baked until golden brown and served with a side of tangy garlic aioli for dipping.

name: Grilled Salmon
longDescription: Wild-caught Atlantic salmon fillet seasoned with herbs and spices, then grilled to perfection. Served with a lemon butter sauce, roasted seasonal vegetables, and your choice of rice pilaf or garlic mashed potatoes.

name: Ribeye Steak
longDescription: 12oz USDA Prime ribeye steak aged for 28 days for maximum flavor and tenderness. Grilled to your preference and finished with herb butter. Served with roasted garlic mashed potatoes and grilled asparagus.

name: Classic Burger
longDescription: Our signature burger features a juicy half-pound Angus beef patty grilled to perfection. Served on a toasted brioche bun with crisp lettuce, ripe tomato, red onion, pickles, and our special house sauce. Comes with a side of crispy seasoned fries.

name: Bacon Cheeseburger
shortDescription: Burger with bacon and melted cheese
longDescription: A mouthwatering half-pound Angus beef patty topped with crispy applewood smoked bacon and melted cheddar cheese. Served on a toasted brioche bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, and our signature sauce. Includes a side of golden seasoned fries.

name: Cheese Pizza
longDescription: Our hand-tossed pizza dough topped with our signature tomato sauce and a blend of mozzarella, provolone, and parmesan cheeses. Baked in a stone oven until the crust is perfectly crispy and the cheese is beautifully melted and bubbling.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
longDescription: Our traditional hand-tossed pizza topped with our signature tomato sauce, generous amounts of mozzarella cheese, and savory pepperoni slices. Stone-baked to perfection with a crispy crust and oven-crisped pepperoni edges.

name: Caesar Salad
longDescription: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in our house-made Caesar dressing with garlic croutons, shaved parmesan cheese, and fresh ground black pepper. Add grilled chicken, shrimp, or salmon for an additional charge.

name: Greek Salad
shortDescription: Mixed greens with feta and olives
longDescription: Fresh mixed greens topped with cucumber, tomato, red onion, kalamata olives, bell peppers, and crumbled feta cheese. Dressed with our Mediterranean olive oil and herb vinaigrette and sprinkled with oregano.

name: French Fries
longDescription: Hand-cut Idaho potatoes fried to golden perfection and tossed with sea salt. Served with your choice of ketchup, garlic aioli, or our signature fry sauce. Available in regular or large size.

name: Onion Rings
longDescription: Thick-cut sweet onions dipped in our special beer batter and fried until golden and crispy. Served with a side of tangy chipotle ranch dipping sauce. The perfect crunchy accompaniment to any meal.

name: Chocolate Cake
longDescription: Decadent triple-layer chocolate cake made with premium cocoa, filled and frosted with silky chocolate ganache. Served with a dollop of fresh whipped cream and a drizzle of raspberry sauce. The perfect dessert for chocolate lovers.

name: Ice Cream Sundae
longDescription: Three scoops of premium vanilla ice cream topped with hot fudge, caramel sauce, whipped cream, crushed nuts, and a maraschino cherry. Customize with your choice of additional toppings for the ultimate dessert experience.

name: Milkshake
longDescription: Hand-spun milkshake made with premium ice cream and your choice of flavor: vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, cookies and cream, or caramel. Topped with whipped cream and appropriate garnishes. Add malt for an additional charge.

name: Lemonade
longDescription: Our signature lemonade made fresh daily with hand-squeezed lemons, filtered water, and pure cane sugar. Available in classic, strawberry, or blueberry flavors. Served over ice with a fresh lemon slice garnish.
